description: This file defines a database migration class for version 4.2 of the OrangeHRM system. It adds new columns to existing tables, inserts new records into module and menu tables, and manages permissions related to maintenance and data purging functionality.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: Represents a database schema migration for OrangeHRM version 4.2, including schema modifications and menu/permission updates.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Executes schema changes, inserts, and menu setup for the migration.

methods.name: insertMenuItems
methods.description: Helper method to insert menu items into the database with specified properties.

methods.name: getScreenId
methods.description: Retrieves the screen ID for a given action URL.
